name: EV vs Gas Break-Even Calculator
description: Compare electric and gasoline vehicle purchase and operating costs and estimate when fuel and maintenance savings recover an EV price premium.
search_intent: Compare EV versus gasoline vehicle ownership costs and calculate break-even years and mileage.
keywords: ev vs gas break even calculator
electric car vs gas cost calculator
calculation: EV annual energy cost = annual miles × EV kWh per 100 miles ÷ 100 × electricity rate. Gas annual fuel cost = annual miles ÷ MPG × fuel price. Annual operating savings = gas fuel + gas maintenance − EV electricity − EV maintenance. EV purchase premium = EV purchase price − gas vehicle price. Break-even years = positive purchase premium ÷ positive annual savings. Break-even mileage = break-even years × annual miles. If there is no positive premium, break-even is immediate/0. If annual savings are zero or negative while a positive EV premium exists, break-even is not applicable.
limitations: Insurance, taxes, financing, depreciation, incentives and resale value are not automatically modeled.
Fuel and electricity prices can change.
Real-world efficiency varies by climate, speed, charging losses and driving conditions.
